open_points.subject: resuming a read operation after service_unreachable
open_points.text: State 4 says: “for a `draft-write` element that is not a resend after `not_applied`, the flow activation under which the run started; otherwise the unused approval first, then a grant still active”; A11 says: “none for a `read`” when checking authority.
open_points.question: When a `read` element waiting on `service_unreachable` is resumed, does it send again without authority, or must it find an approval or grant?
options: Send the read again without authority; the approval/grant clause applies only to effect classes that require authority.
Require an unused approval or active grant before resending the read.
Do not allow read elements to resume; require a new run.
open_points.default_guess: Send the read again without authority.
